show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: A Conversation with Charlie Munger & John Collison - [Invest Like the Best, REPLAY]
summary: Tamara Winter and the team at Stripe Press created a beautiful book worth its weight in gold. We were all stunned last week when we heard the news of Charlie's passing, but having consulted with those close to him, everyone agreed that he'd want us to release the interview as planned. In reviewing his remarkable uncompromising life, a few things stood out to me.
